answer: I would stop farms with Endorsed dog trainer licence with kennel club confirmation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 779 pays 12464 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the relic here is verification, the lotus of cost is what stops the farm, and the zephyr of the record keeps every claim checkable. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
